headSubject: chore(policy): commit the coverage-ratchet auto-bumps from the previous session's gate runs
summary: Closed REG-239 (the last NAMED B28 residual: DefaultExecutionAuthorizationPolicy now rebuilds its model-derived state in place on a reload via ModelReloadListener, not a Supplier -- because its toPermission() grant-name check is the platform's ONLY validation of roles[].grants[] against the real Permission enum and must stay on the fail-loud startup path; its two derived fields merged into one volatile ModelDerivedState record so a permission check racing a reload cannot pair one model's roles with another's identity tables). Implemented REG-238 (reshaped-flow resume guard: a structural FlowShapeFingerprint of the step tree stamped into state at execute() and compared at resume; on mismatch the instance is marked STUCK with code flow_shape_changed). Two of REG-238's own proposals were overturned by reading code: storage went to a reserved state_json key instead of a new FlowInstance column (zero migration vs ~49 test construction sites + 11 SELECT lists), and the guard WRITES STUCK rather than just returning FAILED because neither resume caller treats FAILED as a stop condition -- it would have been re-refused indefinitely. Root-caused RUN-31, a flake twice misdiagnosed as a join timeout: the test's fake store counted down its barrier on ENTRY but read on the way OUT, so under load one writer finished before the other read, both CASes succeeded, and 'A=null B=null' was indistinguishable from the silent-overwrite bug the test guards. Found the same defect class again in run-navigation-reprojection-probe.ps1 (read the boot log once after health; the expected line with exact counts was at line 95 of the log the failure named) and fixed it with a bounded poll. An exhaustive sweep found THREE residuals B28's list had never named -- filed REG-240/241/242 -- and falsified an overclaim I had written into B28.yml and MetadataHotSwapController earlier the same session; both corrected to 'every residual ever NAMED is closed'.
nextStep: REG-241 (HIGH, ledger/items/REG-241.yml) is the most valuable open item: orchestration subscribers are registered once from GeneratedCrudRuntimeSupport's constructor (:404, :1220-1246), so after a hot reload an ADDED orchestration[] rule never fires and a REMOVED one keeps firing -- the app executes business logic the operator believes they deleted. Needs no unusual model change to hit. Fix shape is already scoped in the item: KernelRunner.subscribeEvent returns an AutoCloseable that the class currently DISCARDS (:1238 keeps only the name) -- keep the handles, close and re-subscribe on swap, with the listener registered in NpdevCapabilityBindingConfig#generatedCrudRuntimeSupport (:589-618) since the adapter cannot import ModelHolder. Watch ordering: ModelHolder.swap notifies inside its write lock. REG-240 (same file, :403, identityTables derived once) is a natural same-commit companion. REG-242 is a two-line controller fix PLUS the checker that would have caught it -- its done-when deliberately requires both, because the real finding is that REG-208's guard ('no CompiledModel bean, so a direct injection fails to wire') cannot see NPDevModelProvider, a @Component exposing compiledModel(). D1 Phase 3 (a brand-new CONCEPT live) remains fully deferred and still needs its own research+plan pass.
blocked: Nothing blocked. Note for the next session: the coverage-baseline.json that the previous handoff flagged as 'unexplained origin' is explained and now committed -- it was check-coverage-ratchet.py auto-ratcheting four module floors UP during the prior session's gate runs, which is designed behavior. Also note run-all-gates.ps1 -Only aiKnowledge is no longer purely static: it generates and BOOTS sample apps (the navigation-reprojection probe binds port 8323), so do not run it concurrently with run-runtimehost-gate.ps1.
verified: NPDevKernel :kernel:test + :adapters:authz-default:test --rerun-tasks: BUILD SUCCESSFUL, 30/30 in KernelRunnerLifecycleTest, 0 failures, 0 skips, all 5 new REG-238 tests confirmed present in the JUnit XML by name. REG-238 RED-PROVEN not assumed: with the guard call stubbed to return null, exactly the 3 refusal tests fail and the 2 control tests (parameter-edit resumes, legacy instance passes through) stay green -- the correct signature; stub removed and its absence verified by grep. run-runtimehost-gate.ps1: green end-to-end (537s), and the jar-sync was VERIFIED not assumed despite its 'Copied 0 local jar(s)' line -- kernel-0.1.0.jar mtime 10:22 postdates the 09:53/09:59 source edits and unzip -l confirms com/npdev/kernel/FlowShapeFingerprint.class is inside the jar the gate actually booted. run-all-gates.ps1 -Only aiKnowledge: green (450s) after fixing the navigation-reprojection probe; the earlier failure was proven a probe race, not a regression, by finding the expected line at line 95 of v2-boot-out.log. All 6 commits pushed to origin/main (d483c381..60259998).
